articles.title: Trump floats pulling Blanche’s nomination for attorney general to avoid conceding to GOP demands
articles.description:
After failed negotiations forced the delay of a committee vote to advance Blanche's nomination, Trump suggested he was holding firm against pressure from Republican Sens. John Cornyn and Thom Tillis.

The post Trump floats pulling Blanche’s nomination for attorney general to avoid conceding to GOP demands appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Trump delays Blanche's attorney general nomination amid GOP pressure from Cornyn and Tillis.
Negotiations failed, postponing the committee vote originally scheduled for July 30.
Boston residents may face uncertainty in legal leadership affecting local law enforcement policies.

articles.title: Kayshon Boutte addresses trade rumors, future with Patriots
articles.description:
